title: 第63章 绣春刀，第一次出鞘！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 草是老子的错觉吗？你们有没有发现这小子越战越勇？”“招式太狠了！招招毙命，老子还是第一次见。”“不仅仅是越战越勇，这家伙的招式有点意思，要是他身体再强壮一点，恐怕不用真气和他对战，我们都得死在他的手中。”“……”揍萧棣的一群人也都在议论，还好刚才选择的是萧棣，不然得在唐逸手中吃大亏。“时间到！”宁川走了过来，打量着唐逸。难怪能被陛下看中，这小子，还真不简单！会治病救人，还会一手杀人技……这特娘的，还玩起左手医右手武了？“小子，你过关了，以后，你就是我们一处的人了。”“嗯？你刚才的招式叫什么？”唐逸没有隐瞒，道：“黑龙十八手！”“黑龙十八手？这名字够霸气！”宁川打量着唐逸，道：“这黑龙十八手，是你自己创造的吧？”唐逸想了想，说不是也没有人相信，这些都是他在特种部队学到的。他只好点头道：“为了反抗欺凌，自创自学的，宁头见笑了。”宁川脸皮猛地颤了颤，见笑？老子可不敢！这武技快准狠，很适合近身搏斗。反正连老子都创不出来，敢见笑？一群人再度震惊了，一个不会武功的人，研究出来的武技将他们给打趴下了？娘的，丢人，丢人啊！“行了，时间不多了，现在开始商讨案情。”宁川走回主座。户部的案子没时间耽搁了，要是让二处先破案，那后果不堪设想。“头，我想去见一下我舅舅。”唐逸向前一步，拱手道。柳公瑾现在就关押在南镇抚司，唐逸想要确定一下舅舅的情况，而且……他看向宁川，道：“我舅舅是户部右侍郎柳公瑾，可能会知道一点其他信息。”然而，听到他的话，原本讨论得热火朝天的房间，忽然就安静了下来。唐逸看到宁川的眉头皱了起来，而一处的其他同僚，目光都有些怜悯和幸灾乐祸。这让唐逸的心不由一突，嗯？舅舅该不会出了什么事了吧？不可能吧？老皇帝不是傻逼，舅舅的案子原本是刑部和大理寺查，现在交给了锦衣卫，显然老皇帝也知道舅舅是替罪羊。案子交给锦衣卫，显然是不想让舅舅成替罪羊，如了某些人的愿。将人转到锦衣卫，是为了防止他的人身安全着想……然而想到这里唐逸嘴角已经在抽搐，安全个毛，天底下最不安全的就是特妈是锦衣卫啊！“宁头，我舅在哪？”唐逸急了。宁川揉了揉眉心，这一刻他的心比唐逸还要凉。要不是唐逸提醒，他都忘记柳公瑾和唐逸还有这层关系。可特妈狗曰的二处，已经对柳公瑾过刑了。妈的，现在让这小子见到柳公瑾，天知道这刺头会干出什么事来？“唐逸……”宁川知道现在不能让唐逸见柳公瑾，可是一抬头，那小子的眼睛却一眨不眨地盯着他。眼底有不容拒绝的寒意。宁川武功高强，在整个京都，那都是一等一的好手。但现在面对唐逸的目光，他竟然莫名的……有点小害怕。好吧，你后面是陛下，我惹不起。“嗯，你去吧，这是我的令牌，拿着我的令牌，监牢中的犯人，你都可以审问。”宁川将手中从怀中取出令牌，随手丢给唐逸。“谢宁头。”唐逸接过令牌，拱手离开。“等等我，我跟你一起去。”萧棣双手枕着头，打着哈欠跟在唐逸身后。等两人出了会议室，一处的一众同袍都齐齐看向宁川：“宁头，现在让唐逸去见柳公瑾，不合规矩吧？”柳公瑾是唐逸的舅舅。按照规矩，这种涉及亲属的案件，唐逸是要回避的。“规矩？规矩在他面前算个屁，再说他身边还有燕王殿下，你们拦得住？”宁川直接甩锅给萧棣。当然还有一个最重要的原因，妈的，这是二处捅的篓子，他干嘛要替二处背锅？大家同是锦衣卫没错，可他宁川还讲规矩！“还有，去请一下孙神医过来。”宁川觉得现在唐逸最需要的，是大夫。一群一处的同僚顿时面面相觑，草，咋回事？怎么感觉头儿很迁就唐逸啊！难不成头儿和这家伙，有什么情况不成？唐逸之前和萧棣在锦衣卫监牢待过，算得上轻车熟路了。两人进了监牢，老头立即围了上来，他认识萧棣，自然满脸谄媚：“殿下，您怎么还亲自过来了？”“想要审哪个犯人，您说一声，小的亲自给你提过去。”萧棣懒洋洋地瞥了牢头，道：“柳公瑾在哪个监牢，带路，本王要见他。”老头愣了下，道：“柳公瑾？殿下，柳公瑾现在二处的人不是正在审着吗？”“那老家伙倒是嘴硬，都被吊了一个晚上了，都没有开口。”“现在赵安带着人刚刚过去，今日要是再不开口，估计活不了了。”话音刚落，牢头只感觉周围的温度忽然都降了几分。萧棣察觉到身侧那犀利的杀意，整个人也瞬间精神了：“带路！”老头不敢耽搁，带着两人穿过甬道，来到了锦衣卫的审讯室。刚进门，唐逸便看到一个满身是血的人被捆着手脚吊在半空，他的底下是一缸盐水，但盐水已经被鲜血染红。而此时，赵安正手持皮鞭，一鞭接着一鞭地抽在他的身上。一鞭下去，皮开肉绽。鲜血伴随着盐水滴落在底下的盐水缸。“老东西，老子特妈今日不审你。”“老子今日就是来泄愤的，你那宝贝外甥差点让老子断子绝孙，老子就让你这老匹夫生死两难。”“哈哈，惨叫吧，哀嚎吧……”“……”赵安狞笑，仿佛一头恶魔，正在戏耍自己的猎物。萧棣见到这一幕，顿时怒不可遏。锦衣卫只要证据确凿，可以有先斩后奏之权，但绝对不能滥用私刑，屈打成招。他正想怒斥，只是话还没出口，手便被唐逸抓住，阻止了他。萧棣才发现此时的唐逸脸色冰冷无比，他没有说话，但浑身散发的寒意，让他都感到心悸。唐逸抬步向着赵安走了过去，脚步平缓，没有半点凌乱，而脚步声则是被赵安的狞笑声吞没。而随着不断靠近，他手中的绣春刀也一寸寸拔出。绣春刀，第一次出鞘！
content_en: Is grass an illusion of mine?Have you noticed that this kid gets braver and braver as he fights?"The moves are too cruel!"It's the first time I've seen this killing method."Not only does he become braver as he fights, but this guy's moves are a bit interesting. If he were stronger, I wouldn't have to fight him with his true energy, and we would all die in his hands.""..." The group of people who beat Xiao Di were also talking. Fortunately, it was Xiao Di who was chosen just now, otherwise they would have suffered a big loss at the hands of Tang Yi. "Time's up!""Ning Chuan walked over and looked at Tang Yi. No wonder he was favored by His Majesty. This boy is really not easy! He can cure diseases and save people, and he also has killing skills... This damn girl, you can also use left-handed medicine and right-handed martial arts? "Boy, you passed the test. From now on, you will be a member of our department.""Um?What was the name of the move you just made?"Tang Yi didn't hide anything, and said: "The Eighteen Hands of the Black Dragon!"The Black Dragon's Eighteen Hands?"This name is quite domineering!Ning Chuan looked at Tang Yi and said, "Did you create these Eighteen Black Dragon Hands yourself?""Tang Yi thought for a moment, and no one would believe him if he said otherwise. He learned these things in the special forces. He could only nod his head and said, "In order to resist bullying, I created and taught myself. Ning Tou laughs at it."Ning Chuan's face suddenly trembled. Are you laughing? I don't dare! This martial art is fast, accurate and cruel, and is very suitable for close combat. Anyway, even I can't create it. How dare you laugh? A group of people were shocked again. A person who didn't know martial arts defeated them with the martial arts he developed? Damn it, it's embarrassing, it's embarrassing! "Okay, time is running out, let's start discussing the case now."Ning Chuan walked back to the main seat. There is no time to delay the case of the Household Department. If the Second Department is allowed to solve the case first, the consequences will be disastrous. "Boss, I want to see my uncle."Tang Yi took a step forward and cupped his hands. Liu Gongjin is currently being held in Nanzhen Fusi. Tang Yi wanted to confirm his uncle's situation, and... he looked at Ning Chuan and said, "My uncle is Liu Gongjin, the right minister of the Ministry of Revenue. He may know some other information."However, after hearing his words, the room where the discussion was originally in full swing suddenly became quiet. Tang Yi saw Ning Chuan's brows furrowed, and the other colleagues in the first department had some pity and gloating in their eyes. This made Tang Yi's heart skip a beat, huh? Could something have happened to his uncle? It's impossible, right? The old emperor was not an idiot. His uncle's case was originally investigated by the Ministry of Punishment and Dali Temple.Now it is handed over to Jin Yiwei. Obviously the old emperor also knows that his uncle is a scapegoat.He obviously does not want his uncle to be a scapegoat and fulfills the wishes of some people.The reason for transferring him to Jin Yiwei is to prevent his personal safety... However, the corner of Tang Yi's mouth is twitching at the thought. The most unsafe thing in the world is that the special mother is Jin Yiwei!"Ningtou, where is my uncle?"Tang Yi was anxious. Ning Chuan rubbed his eyebrows. At this moment, his heart was even colder than Tang Yi's. If Tang Yi hadn't reminded him, he would have forgotten that Liu Gongjin and Tang Yi still have this relationship. But the two parts of Te Mama Dog Day have alreadyLiu Gongjin has been punished.Damn it, God knows what will happen to this kid if he sees Liu Gongjin now?"Tang Yi..." Ning Chuan knew that Tang Yi could not see Liu Gongjin now, but he raised his eyebrows.He looked at him without blinking.There was an undeniable chill in his eyes.Ning Chuan was a top martial artist in all of Kyoto.But now he was inexplicably...a little scared when he faced Tang Yi's gaze."Well, you can go ahead. This is my token. You can interrogate the prisoners in the prison.""Ning Chuan took out the token from his arms and threw it to Tang Yi. "Xie Ningtou."Tang Yi took the token and left. "Wait for me, I'll go with you."Xiao Di rested his head on his hands and yawned as he followed Tang Yi. When the two of them left the conference room, all the colleagues in the same room looked at Ning Chuan: "Ning Tou, isn't it against the rules to let Tang Yi go see Liu Gongjin now?"Liu Gongjin is Tang Yi's uncle. According to the rules, Tang Yi has to avoid such cases involving relatives. "Rules?Rules are nothing in front of him. Besides, there is His Highness Prince Yan by his side. Can you stop him?"Ning Chuan directly passed the blame to Xiao Di. Of course, there is another most important reason. Damn it, this is the fault of the Second Division. Why should he take the blame for the Second Division? It's true that we are all Jin Yiwei, but Ning Chuan still follows the rules! "Also, go and ask Divine Doctor Sun to come over."Ning Chuan feels that what Tang Yi needs most now is a doctor. A group of colleagues in the same department suddenly looked at each other, what's going on? Why does it feel like the boss is so accommodating to Tang Yi! Could it be that there's something going on between the boss and this guy??Tang Yi and Xiao Di had been in Jinyiwei Prison before, so they were familiar with each other.When the two entered the prison, the old man immediately surrounded him. He knew Xiao Di, so he was naturally flattering: "Your Highness, why did you come here in person?"Just tell me which prisoner you want to interrogate, and I will bring it to you personally."Xiao Di glanced lazily at the prison head and said, "Which prison is Liu Gongjin in? Lead the way. I want to see him."The old man was stunned for a moment and said, "Liu Gongjin?"Your Highness, isn't Liu Gongjin currently being interrogated by people from the Second Division?"That old guy was very stubborn. He was hung up all night and didn't even speak.""Now Zhao An has just passed by with his people. If he doesn't speak today, he probably won't survive.""As soon as he finished speaking, the cell leader felt that the temperature around him suddenly dropped a bit. Xiao Di noticed the sharp murderous intention beside him, and his whole body became energetic instantly: "Lead the way!"The old man didn't dare to delay, and led the two of them through the corridor to the interrogation room of Jin Yiwei. As soon as he entered the door, Tang Yi saw a man covered in blood, his hands and feet tied and hanging in the air. Under him was a tank of salt water, but the salt water had been freshly soaked.The blood was stained red.At this time, Zhao An was holding a whip and whipped him one after another.The skin was torn and the blood was dripping into the salt water tank below."Old man, I won't judge you today.""I'm here to vent my anger today. Your precious nephew almost made me cut off my children, so I put you, an old man, in a dilemma of life and death.""Haha, scream, howl..." "..." Zhao An smiled ferociously, like a demon, playing with his prey. When Xiao Di saw this scene, he was furious. As long as the evidence is solid, the Jin Yiwei has the right to kill first and then report, but he must not abuse lynching and beat him into submission.
